newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet eases with IPE gas oil, premiums steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet eases with IPE gas oil, premiums steady.

text.p: Jet fuel prices declined in line with IPE gas oil futures on Tuesday, but premiums were steady.
Nov IPE gas oil shed $2.50 to close at $231.25 a tonne.
One trader said there was a shortage of small, prompt 10,000 tonne parcels in NWE. Cargo premiums in the north were steady in the low 30s cif and in the Med were around Nov IPE +$17.
One refiner said with European diesel trading above jet, he was selling all his jet into the diesel pool, and that this "absurd situation" could not last more than a few days.
